response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and mobile/embedded background, but his resume shows minimal Java exposure (used briefly for robotics/device orchestration tools) and no evidence of Kotlin, Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus, or JVM-focused tooling work, which are core requirements for this role. His skills list does not include Kotlin or Spring, and there's no demonstrated interest in IDE internals or JVM language tooling specifically.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-caliber engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Strong track record of ownership, architecture, and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, clean code)
Experience building developer tools and CLI/test frameworks (e.g., Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts)
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience and only minimal, dated Java exposure — not enterprise-grade
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate or other enterprise JVM frameworks required for the role
No evidence of IDE internals or language tooling experience specific to JVM ecosystems

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/enterprise JVM framework experience
No Kotlin experience and superficial Java background
Strong general software craftsmanship and tooling-building experience
